flowchart TD
    subgraph SourcesLayer["Secret 來源層"]
        OSKey["OS Keychain<br/>(macOS security / Windows cmdkey)"]
        Ephemeral["Ephemeral Generator<br/>openssl rand -hex"]
        GHSec["GitHub Encrypted Secrets<br/>(Repo Settings)"]
        K8sGen["mittwald<br/>kubernetes-secret-generator<br/>(in-cluster)"]
    end

    subgraph LocalDev["Developer Local（LOCAL_DEPLOY §3.5）"]
        BootScript["bootstrap-secrets.sh<br/>(層 1+2 Bootstrap)"]
        LocalEnv[".env.local<br/>(ephemeral, .gitignore)"]
        LocalK8sSec["K8s Secrets (erp-token-local ns)<br/>erp-token-db-secret<br/>erp-token-app-secret<br/>gitea-admin-secret"]
    end

    subgraph CIRunner["GitHub Actions Runner"]
        WfSec["secrets context<br/>${{ secrets.* }}"]
        WfStep["Workflow Steps<br/>(test / build / deploy)"]
    end

    subgraph Deploy["Staging / Production K8s"]
        K8sSec["K8s Secrets<br/>(erp-token-staging / -prod ns)<br/>erp-token-db-secret<br/>erp-token-app-secret"]
        AppPod["App Pod<br/>env: secretKeyRef"]
        TLSSec["TLS Cert Secret<br/>(auto-generated by mittwald)"]
    end

    OSKey -->|"GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD<br/>GHCR_TOKEN (local-only)"| BootScript
    Ephemeral -->|"DB_PASSWORD / HMAC_SECRET<br/>DATA_PROTECTION_KEY / JWT_SECRET<br/>(per-run random 32-64 bytes)"| BootScript
    BootScript --> LocalEnv
    BootScript --> LocalK8sSec

    Ephemeral -->|"per-CI-run random"| GHSec
    OSKey -.->|"manual: gh secret set<br/>(SRE one-time)"| GHSec
    GHSec -->|"injected at runtime"| WfSec
    WfSec --> WfStep
    WfStep -->|"kubectl create secret<br/>(via kubeconfig from GH Secret)"| K8sSec
    K8sGen -.->|"in-cluster auto-gen"| TLSSec
    K8sSec -->|"valueFrom.secretKeyRef"| AppPod
    TLSSec -->|"tls.crt / tls.key"| AppPod
    LocalK8sSec -.->|"valueFrom.secretKeyRef (local only)"| AppPod

    classDef prod fill:#d1e7dd,stroke:#198754
